label: Every window of the White House lit under a storm, trees stripped bare
description: A major storm over Washington with the White House lit and glowing in every window, and the trees on the grounds stripped of leaves and limbs as after a tornado, with limbs across the lawn. He states the lights represent something rather than being literal.
aliases: lights were all on in every window
stripped bare
Pay attention to that

label: A glow on the Niagara river and no light at all across in Canada
description: Looking northeast from Washington he sees a glow on the river at Niagara Falls, and across the border into Canada great darkness, which he specifies is absence of light rather than evil.
aliases: a glow on that river
It is dark. It is dark
I could see no light

label: A three-leaved sprout in the centre of Cuba, a lifeline from Russia
description: A line runs into Cuba where a bean sprout with three leaves springs up in the centre of the island, and he is told new financial opportunities will open as a lifeline to Cuba from Russia, with strategic alliances tried for BRICS on a greater scale.
aliases: three leaves on this plant
a lifeline to Cuba from Russia

label: Revival at Living Word in Minnesota, on the prayers of its founding intercessor
description: The church at Living Word in Minnesota named repeatedly, with its founding pastors wife seen as a young woman travailing in prayer, intercessors catching fire from her, a receding of attendance and then another wave. He says he is not familiar with the church.
aliases: Living Word
Minnesota, Minnesota, Minnesota
she was travailing for the lost

label: Named churches become Azusa Street strong points
description: Living Word, Collinsville, Branson, Fort Worth, Eagle Mountain, California and Karis Bible College in Colorado Springs named as multiple Azusa Street strong points, like pillars of fire, drawing people from everywhere. The named list is what makes this checkable rather than general.

Eagle Mountain
Caris Bible College

label: A modern-day Azusa Street in Hawaii
description: A major revival in Hawaii, a place he says is not on anyone's prayer radar, drawing people from all the islands, conditional on a Pentecostal church there planting itself and calling it in.

a modern-day Isuzu in a a Hawaii

description: Revival in Hollywood with supernatural visitations on celebrities, A-list conversions, meetings held in mansions, and a move of God in the movie theatres.

France, Minnesota
prayer warriors in both places

label: The more Democratic the place, the greater the revival
description: Stated as a rule while naming Hawaii, Alaska and Hollywood: the greater the blue, the greater the liberal, the greater the revival. A general principle rather than a single event, which makes it testable against attendance and affiliation data.
